parent_success_inputs.balance: Equal replay draw per group and per recorded age, then equally per development seed. Keep all parent-success worlds in both strata; use no heldout input.
parent_success_inputs.targets: Parent deterministic 14-D raw output, validated on the stored 61-D actor inputs. The requested posture is only a training record tag.

single_factor.candidate_coefficient_gate: Choose and freeze one bounded coefficient only after the CPU optimizer fixture verifies zero-coefficient parity, nonzero actor-only gradient at the candidate checkpoint, and group-balanced sampling.
single_factor.change: Add one parent-action mean retention term on the two qualified groups during the first second after release.
single_factor.shared: Both arms retain actual-supine PPO weight 2 and the existing successful-action constraint. Carry the same weighted checkpoint networks, normalizers and Adam states. Keep rewards, critic targets, observations, hardware interface and action projection identical.

proposed_gate: Keep all current original per-group and overall gates, early and final holds and actual release coverage. Against matched training control seek at least two additional actual-right successes and at least one additional requested-supine success, without reducing actual-supine success versus the fixed weighted starting model. Prefer an unmodified continuation that passes, and use separate confirmation for any selected model.
required_checks: Build and hash the two replay groups from the qualified saved observations; verify parent ONNX parity and balanced sample provenance.
Test the extra actor gradient on a temporary CPU clone and preserve the critic, Adam baseline, RNG and other loss paths at zero coefficient.
Freeze the run name, seed, coefficient, budgets and independent evaluator before actual GPU startup in the existing VS Code shared terminal.
